🐾 Welcome to Soper Creek Wildlife Rescue’s YouTube Channel! 🌿

Get ready to meet the incredible animals of Soper Creek Wildlife Rescue, where every critter is a native Canadian species! From heartwarming rescues to fascinating wildlife facts, we’re here to connect you with Ontario’s amazing wildlife.

Located in Clarington, just an hour outside of Toronto, SCWR is proud to be Durham Region's ONLY Wildlife Rehabilitation Hospital. Our mission is to RESCUE, REHABILITATE, and RELEASE Ontario’s wildlife while educating communities about their importance

✨ What You’ll Find on Our Channel:

Weekly videos every #WildlifeWednesday featuring animal ambassadors and rescue stories.
Behind-the-scenes looks at wildlife rehabilitation in action.
Subscribe today to join us on our journey to protect and celebrate Canada’s wildlife!
